projection.retained: All scenarios, all assertions including expected/actual/outcome, all original totals, CLI stdout/stderr, manifests, filesystem diffs and temporary leftovers.
projection.omitted: Raw argv, GG environment values and setup metadata; complete tree snapshots except S08/S11. No assertion or failure is omitted or regraded.
projection.substitutions: Only the checkout and QA scratch prefixes become role aliases. Relative paths, values, ordering and all outcomes stay unchanged.

method.supplements: qa-434-reset-locks.mjs (13 cases, run unchanged); these controls never replace its results
method.isolation: minimal child env; GG_DATA_DIR a fixture (T09: unset, with HOME/USERPROFILE inside the fixture and a dry-run gate on the printed data directory); TEMP inside the run folder
method.grading: completion/failure-message checks are wording-neutral: a line naming the path as its own token plus the claimed effect, compared with the after tree

kinds.interpretive: QA reading beyond the acceptance text; not gating
kinds.precondition: fixture precondition; dependent checks skipped when it fails
